description: Compute a row count, distinct byte value count or checked signed total for each supplied group.

interface.semantic_input: Finite ordered groups of positioned rows with byte-valued key and field strings.
interface.semantic_output: One owned row per group with the original key fields, decimal measure text and a new one-based result position.

parameters.value_column: Zero-based input field for distinct and sum

implementation_form: retained C++ adapter with extracted DuckDB row kernels
resources: Materializes measurements in a relation and returns an owned row sequence. Maximum group count, throughput and peak memory are unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Select a supported measure and ordering. Distinct and sum require the selected field to exist in each nonempty group. Sum operands must parse as signed 64-bit integers.

postconditions.detail: Returned the expected key and decimal measure for every supplied group with fresh one-based positions. Empty groups returned zero and equal group keys remained separate.

refinements.detail: Distinct counts preserved byte distinctions including NUL. Sum returned signed extrema for the tested cancellation cases and rejected positive and negative totals outside the signed result range.

effects.detail: Ordinary file programs preserved an existing destination or left it absent on tested short-field, malformed-number and overflow failures. File I/O belongs to the surrounding providers.

invariants.detail: Tied numeric measures retained group order under both tested sort directions. Count ignored the field index in the tested cases.

mathematical_properties.detail: Finite observations provide no general overflow, ordering or complexity proof.

formal_predicates.detail: The detached scope records tested cases and executable evidence.

state_protocol.detail: Tested invalid arguments or operands failed before returning a result producer. Successful producers returned the same rows on repeated visits.

ownership.detail: The client consumed the returned rows twice after the input groups had been destroyed.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent invocation and consumption were untested.

upstream_usage.detail: The retained adapter uses the registered count and sum aggregates. The signed source closure and historical executed factory and partition symbols are pinned.

specification_question.detail: Which measure, field and result order should apply to each group?
